usageNotes: Call this before initiating a VM migration to check whether the migration is feasible. The response identifies blocking local resources (e.g. passthrough PCI/USB devices), local disks that cannot follow the VM, storage unavailability on candidate nodes, and HA affinity constraints — all of which must be resolved before POST migrate will succeed. Pass an optional `target` node to get a targeted feasibility report including `not_allowed_nodes` detail for all other cluster members.

examples.summary: Check migration preconditions for VM 105 on node pve1, scoped to target node pve2

tips: If `local_resources` is non-empty, live migration is impossible without removing or mapping the listed PCI/USB devices first.
Local disks (especially CD-ROM images or disks on non-shared storage) listed in `local_disks` must be moved to shared storage or the migration must use offline mode.
`dependent-ha-resources` lists HA resources that will automatically follow the VM to the target — verify the target node satisfies their affinity rules before migrating.
Use the `mapped-resource-info` field (not the deprecated `mapped-resources`) to determine whether any mapped resources support live migration.
A `running: true` response means the VM is live; factor this in when choosing between live and offline migration via the POST endpoint.
